P.name: Trial by Fire
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Gangplank''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to set the target on fire, dealing them{{ft|{{pplevel|50 to 250|color=true damage}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} over {{fd|2.5}} seconds.|{{pplevel|50/10 to 250/10|color=true damage}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over {{fd|2.5}} seconds.}}{{tip|turret|Turrets}} are dealt 50% damage.
P.description2: If '''Gangplank''' successfully hits a target with ''Trial by Fire'', he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pplevel|15 to 30|key=%}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds. Every time a ''{{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}'' explodes, the {{sti|cooldown}} for ''Trial by Fire'' resets and '''Gangplank''' gains its {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
P.description3: ''Trial by Fire cannot be applied with {{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank}} nor {{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}.''

Q.name: Parrrley
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gangplank''' fires a shot at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects as a {{tip|ranged}} attack, and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
Q.description2: If ''Parrrley'' kills the target, '''Gangplank''' plunders {{g|gold}} and [[File:Silver Serpents.png|20px|link=]] ''Silver Serpents''. Each enemy killed by a ''{{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}'' explosion that was originally set off by ''Parrrley'' also counts for the plunder.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Gold Plunder|{{g|{{ap|3 to 7}}}}}}
{{st|Silver Serpent Plunder|[[File:Silver Serpents.png|20px|link=]] {{ap|4 to 8}}}}
Q.description3: [[File:Silver Serpents.png|20px|link=]] ''Silver Serpents'' can be spent while at the [[shop]] to upgrade ''{{ai|Cannon Barrage|Gangplank}}''.

W.name: Remove Scurvy
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gangplank''' consumes a large quantity of citrus fruit, {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself from all {{tip|crowd control}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself.

E.name: Powder Keg
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gangplank''' consumes a charge to place a powder keg at the target location that lasts for 25 seconds and will connect to other kegs with overlapping connection radius through a trail of black powder. The keg starts with {{as|3 health}} and loses {{as|1|health}} every {{pp|2;1;0.5|1;7;13}} seconds until it is left with {{as|1 health}}.
E.description2: '''Gangplank''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Powder Keg'' charge, up to a maximum.
E.description3: Kegs can be {{tip|basic attack|attacked}} by enemies or '''Gangplank''' (including his ''{{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank}}''), dealing 1 damage to it. When an enemy destroys it, it is safely defused. When '''Gangplank''' destroys it, it explodes and also triggers a chain reaction that explodes other nearby connected kegs with a {{rutngt|0.3}}-delay between explosions. The explosions also grant {{tip|sight}} of their radiuses for 2 seconds.
E.description4: Enemies caught in an explosion are dealt the triggering {{tt|{{as|attack's damage}}|see notes}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 2 seconds. Against champions, the explosion also deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}. Each enemy can only be hit once per chain and the damage dealt ignores {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|40% of the target's armor}}}}.
E.description5: ''The triggering attack on the keg can {{tip|critically strike}}, causing the explosion to deal the attack's critical damage.''

R.name: Cannon Barrage
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gangplank''' shoots a flare into the air, signaling his ship off-shore to fire upon the target location, calling down 12 waves of cannonballs in clusters of 3 every 2 seconds, each wave in a cluster hitting {{fd|0.25}} seconds after the other, and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for the duration. Each wave deals {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies within the area and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 30% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage Per Wave|{{ap|40 to 100}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Magic Damage Per Cluster|{{ap|40*3 to 100*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*3}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|40*12 to 100*12}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*12}}% AP)}}}}
R.description2: While within the [[shop]] area, '''Gangplank''' can purchase upgrades for his ship at the cost of 500 ''{{ai|Silver Serpents|Gangplank}}'' each, which improve ''Cannon Barrage'' with new effects:
R.description3: {{sbc|{{ii|Death's Daughter}}:}} A large cannonball lands in the center of the barrage after the first cluster of waves occur, dealing a cluster's worth of {{as|true damage}} to enemies within the impact and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 75% for 1 second.
R.leveling3:
{{st|True Damage with {{ii|Death's Daughter}}|{{ap|40*3 to 100*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*3}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Mixed Damage with {{ii|Death's Daughter}}|{{ap|40*12+40*3 to 100*12+100*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*12+10*3}}% AP)}}}}
R.description4: {{sbc|{{ii|Fire at Will}}:}} ''Cannon Barrage'' fires{{ft|6 additional waves|2 additional clusters}}over its duration; 18 waves of cannonballs are called down in clusters of 3 every {{fd|1.3{{recurring|3}}}} seconds.
R.leveling4:
{{st|Total Magic Damage with {{ii|Fire at Will}}|{{ap|40*18 to 100*18}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*18}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Maximum Mixed Total Damage with {{ii|Fire at Will}} and {{ii|Death's Daughter}}|{{ap|40*18+40*3 to 100*18+100*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*18+10*3}}% AP)}}}}
R.description5: {{sbc|{{ii|Raise Morale}}:}} ''Cannon Barrage'' grants '''Gangplank''' and all allies within the area {{sti|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, lingering for 2 seconds.
